mapper.select: SELECT mcp_server_version_id AS version_id, version_no, readiness, last_update_time FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT s.mcp_server_id, s.server_code, s.server_name, s.description, s.latest_version_id, s.latest_version_no, v.transport_type, v.endpoint FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server s JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version v ON v.mcp_server_version_id = s.latest_version_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.latest_readiness = 'READY' ORDER BY s.server_name ASC, s.id ASC
